- What did I notice in people’s faces or voices that made the moment feel real?  
- How did I feel walking away from that experience?

Even a few honest sentences can capture the heart of it. And remember, your care and intention are already a big part of what will make your post resonate. Keep trusting yourself and giving yourself space to reflect—your voice and perspective are valuable, and your readers will feel that.

You’re doing great. Keep going, and let yourself enjoy the process of remembering and sharing what mattered most to you.
